additional_requirements.title: Test automation of deployments
additional_requirements.text: For each deployment process, ensure it is automated.

additional_requirements.title: Test reproducibility of the deployment environment
additional_requirements.text: Verify that the deployment/production environment is reproducible.

additional_requirements.title: Test limitation of access to the production environment
additional_requirements.text: Verify that the production environment is accessible only to trusted and qualified users.

additional_requirements.title: Test non-usage of default passwords
additional_requirements.text: For each deployment tool, ensure the password is not the default one.
